Lesson 34. Perfect and Diminished Intervals

Intervals a half step smaller than perfect intervals are called diminished. Lowering the upper note by a half step will form a diminished interval from a perfect one. The symbol for diminished is a o.

P4 o4 P5 o5 Perfect oOctave Octave

Raising the lower note by a half step also will form a diminished interval from a perfect one.

P4 o4 P5 o5 Perfect oOctave Octave

Practice

1. Write the indicated perfect interval then the diminished interval above each given note.

P4 o4 P5 o5 Perfect oOctave Octave

2. Write the indicated perfect interval then the diminished interval below each given note.

P4 o4 P5 o5 Perfect oOctave Octave

3. Identify each interval with its complete name.
